title: Geometry - Lesson 8 Assessment: Polygon Angle Sums
description: Show mastery of polygon angle-sum patterns, regular polygon angles, missing angles, and side counts.

questions.question: Which statement best explains why the formula (n - 2) x 180 works for polygon angle sums?
options: Every side of a polygon measures 180 degrees.
An n-sided polygon can be split into n - 2 triangles from one vertex.
A polygon always has n - 2 angles.
questions.explanation: Drawing diagonals from one vertex divides an n-sided polygon into n - 2 triangles, each with angle sum 180 degrees.

questions.question: Find the interior angle sum of a pentagon. Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: A pentagon has 5 sides, so (5 - 2) x 180 = 3 x 180 = 540.

questions.question: What is the interior angle sum of an octagon?
questions.explanation: An octagon has 8 sides, so (8 - 2) x 180 = 6 x 180 = 1080 degrees.

questions.question: A polygon has an interior angle sum of 1260 degrees. How many sides does it have? Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: (n - 2) x 180 = 1260. Divide by 180 to get n - 2 = 7, so n = 9.

questions.question: One interior angle of a regular decagon measures how many degrees?
questions.explanation: A decagon has total angle sum (10 - 2) x 180 = 1440. Divide by 10 to get 144 degrees.

questions.question: A hexagon has five interior angles measuring 110, 125, 120, 130, and 105 degrees. Find the sixth angle. Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: A hexagon's angle sum is 720. The known angles add to 590, so the missing angle is 720 - 590 = 130.

questions.question: A 12-sided polygon can be divided into 10 triangles from one vertex.
questions.explanation: For n = 12, the number of triangles is n - 2 = 10.

questions.question: Find one interior angle of a regular pentagon. Enter just the number.
questions.explanation: The total angle sum is (5 - 2) x 180 = 540. Divide by 5: 540 / 5 = 108.

questions.question: A polygon has an interior angle sum of 1800 degrees. How many sides does it have?
A student says the interior angle sum of a regular octagon is 135 degrees. Explain the mistake and give the correct total angle sum.
questions.correctAnswer: The student found one interior angle, not the total. A regular octagon has total angle sum (8 - 2) x 180 = 1080 degrees, and 1080 divided by 8 is 135 degrees for one angle.
questions.explanation: The key distinction is between the total interior angle sum and one interior angle of a regular polygon.
